FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
Deli Delights operates as a delicatessen and sandwich shop, specializing in the assembly of fresh sandwiches and salads using high-quality, pre-prepared ingredients. Our focus is on providing a fast-casual dining experience in a clean, friendly environment. We take pride in sourcing our ingredients from licensed, reputable vendors to ensure both quality and safety. 

Our operations utilize household-type appliances, such as microwave ovens and toasters, to maintain compliance with health regulations. We do not engage in any on-premises cooking or deep frying, and there is no sale of alcoholic beverages. Our service model emphasizes take-out orders, with no delivery vehicles operated by the business, ensuring a straightforward and efficient service approach. 

To stay aligned with health and safety standards, all staff undergo regular food safety training. We strictly adhere to local health department regulations, supporting our commitment to food safety and customer satisfaction. Our annual gross revenue is maintained below $500,000, allowing us to focus on serving our community without the complexities often associated with larger operations.
